lastCompletedStory.title: Wire the counter + PRD content-hash into the marker writer

nextStoryContext: US-003 gates the auto-chain re-dispatch on the marker US-002 now writes with real consecutiveCount/keyHash/escalated. Gate site is runSidecarLoop's flipActiveFn auto-chain block in src/supervisor/loop.ts (grep 'US-005: Auto-chain in auto mode' / 'opts.flipActiveFn !== undefined && opts.hasPendingStories'). Inject a readImplementBlockedMarkerFn?: () => ImplementBlockedMarker | null seam defaulting to a no-op returning null (existing callers/tests stay byte-for-byte unchanged); when the read marker has escalated:true, skip the flipActiveFn call and leave the loop active:false. Production wiring goes in src/commands/sidecar.ts, which already imports readImplementBlockedMarker + IMPLEMENT_BLOCKED_FILENAME (sidecar.ts:49) -- reuse readImplementBlockedMarker(join(claudeDir, IMPLEMENT_BLOCKED_FILENAME)) directly, do not reimplement the read. Record the halt via the existing emit/logEvent path (reuse an existing WorkerEventKind such as 'sidecar-exit' or the meta-loop-dispatch skip-reason enum); the story's AC4 explicitly forbids inventing a new WorkerEventKind. Recovery path already exists: clearImplementBlockedMarkerForCurrentIssue (sidecar.ts, wired into makeProductionRearmImplementingFn) removes the marker on a DONE outcome for the matching issueId, and US-002's advanceBlockedMarker resets consecutiveCount/escalated to a fresh state on any prd.json content change -- US-003 only needs to READ the marker at the gate point, not touch either clear/reset path.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Bun.CryptoHasher('sha256').update() accepts Buffer/Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer/string; .digest('hex') returns a hex string. Confirmed the host.ts computePrdHashForBlockedMarker implementation (readFileSync(prdPath) Buffer fed directly into .update()) matches the current public API.
